body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2024-10-29 (Q2FY25 concall transcript): "Yes, absolutely. I think all those expectations are definitely still continuing." Metric: Consolidated revenue. Target: 25% CAGR FY25-FY27; INR 10,000 cr by ~FY29. Deadline: 2029-03-31 (interim check FY26/FY27). Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: silently-dropped. Evidence: Not repeated in any later call (grep of 8 later transcripts). Three months later (Feb-25) management 'would refrain from putting any specific guidance numbers'. Revenue growth since: FY25 +41%, FY26 +20%, FY27 guide +15%. Note: FY24->FY27e CAGR is ~25% if FY27 delivers +15%, and INR 10,000 cr by FY29 still needs ~25% p.a. in FY28-29. So the target is still reachable, but it was abandoned without comment.
